subject: Kicklaunch: cadence, attendee roster, and calendar links
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@healthlytix.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Tony Brooks <t.brooks@healthlytix.com>
Date: 2027-10-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Healthlytix x Redwood — kickoff week availability

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to get the kickoff scheduled and align on roles, security onboarding, and the initial implementation sprint. We’re targeting the week of Nov 1 for a 60–90 minute kickoff.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tues Nov 2, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Nov 3, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Nov 4, 09:00–10:30

Could you confirm which of those works for Redwood and share a draft attendee list + agenda? If you have an internal on-call who will rotate bridges or handle overflow, please note that as well.

Attached: Healthlytix_MAAP.xlsx (overview of key data flows).

Looking forward —
Claire Huang
Head of Integrations, Healthlytix
claire@healthlytix.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Claire Huang <claire@healthlytix.com>, Tony Brooks <t.brooks@healthlytix.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-28T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Healthlytix x Redwood — kickoff week availability

Hi Claire — great to hear. All three windows look doable; my preference is Wed Nov 3 13:00–14:30 PST to give the engineering teams time to prepare. If that’s OK with you I’ll send a calendar invite.

Draft attendee roster (Redwood):
- Stephanie Nguyen — Customer Success (owner)
- Jonas Weber — Solutions Engineer (technical lead / bridge owner)
- Ben Carter — Onboarding Engineer (SSO & infra runbook)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Reliability (escalation contact)

Requested Healthlytix attendees:
- Product owner (PM) — primary decision maker
- Lead Backend Engineer — SSO & APIs
- Security/Compliance contact — SOC 2 / data handling

Draft agenda (60–90 min):
1) Intros & goals (10 min)
2) High-level architecture & data flows (15–20 min)
3) Security/compliance checklist & evidence handoff (10–15 min)
4) Implementation plan / sprint 0 milestones (20 min)
5) Ops & escalation playbook / next steps (10 min)

Links & docs I will attach/send with the invite: Kicklaunch_Agenda_v1.docx (detailed agenda), short Ops runbook stub.

Please confirm Wed Nov 3 13:00–14:30 PST and add Nadia (your PM) if she should be on the invite. Once confirmed I’ll add the Zoom link and a calendar event (we’ll include a backup bridge rotation).

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Attachments: Kicklaunch_Agenda_v1.docx (docx)

> Please confirm Wed Nov 3 13:00–14:30 PST and add Nadia (your PM) if she should be on the invite.

Hi all — Wed Nov 3 13:00 PST works on my side. I’ll own the primary bridge and backup rotation. Proposed joining details (will paste final Zoom link in the invite):

Primary: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=kicklaunch (hosted by Redwood)
Backup (if host fails): https://meetbox.redwood.internal/ops-bridge-2

Operational notes for the kickoff: please have the Healthlytix backend engineer prepared to share live curl of the token exchange or a short sequence diagram for the integration flow — that will save time. We’ll use the first 10 minutes of the implementation plan to confirm SSO and cert exchange owners.

I’ve attached a short file with the bridge rotation and who to page if the host can’t start: bridge-ops.txt (attachment stub).

—Jonas
